facts.fact: Reuben 疑惑她没取肉桂却杀了人。
facts.anchor: “She never picked up the cinnamon? How did she manage to kill him?”

facts.fact: 情报显示死者有隐秘的肉桂过敏。
facts.anchor: he had a hidden allergy to…cinnamon

facts.fact: Reuben 追问她怎么可能知道。
Colby 怀疑从一开始就是她的计划。
facts.anchor: That from the very beginning, this was her plan.

facts.fact: Orzo 催他付钱给杀手、再雇一次。
facts.anchor: “Pay the hitman. Hire them again,” Orzo pushes.

facts.fact: 他拍肩时 Orzo 没有躲开。
Orzo 说自己找到了幸运符。
她问能否付现金或银行转账。
facts.anchor: Bitcoin? Can I just get cash or direct deposit into a bank account.

facts.fact: 她问客户是否喜欢那份烩饭。
facts.anchor: I hope they enjoyed the risotto.

facts.fact: 她问能否一次做不止一颗人头。
facts.anchor: If possible, can I do more than one head at a time?

facts.fact: Reuben 惊觉自己可能遇上连环杀人魔。
facts.anchor: Holy shit, had I stumbled on a mass murderer?

facts.fact: 她要一个装剩菜的陶瓷锅。
facts.anchor: Just in case, a ceramic pot for leftovers so they can heat it up after I leave.

facts.fact: 这个要求让他的血都凉了。
facts.anchor: Ice enters my blood at her request.

facts.fact: 他决定先睡，再安排更多谋杀。
facts.anchor: First I sleep, and then I set up a few more murders.
